description: Galen, On the Mixtures and Powers of Simple Drugs (De simplicium medicamentorum temperamentis ac facultatibus), books 1-11: a machine first draft in English with the Greek beside it, two independent renderings, the machine checks and the passages the checks flag. Unverified; for reading and correcting.
prior_translations: No complete published translation into English by a scholar that we know of. An English translation of books 1-5 by J. Wilkins is announced in the Cambridge Galen Translations. Books 6-8: a French translation with the Greek by C. Manco (doctoral thesis, Montpellier and Bologna, 2020). The prefaces of books 6-11 and the first two entries of book 6: English by M. Coughlin (ancientmedicine.org, 2023). All eleven books: a free French version by H. Fayard (1548). An unreviewed machine translation into English of Kühn XI and XII, the volumes containing these books, was posted at Source Library (sourcelibrary.org) during 2026.
